diagnostics.message: module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app registers the GitHub App webhook via local-exec using the endpoint URL built from module.multi-runner:output.webhook. That endpoint value only references aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook.api_endpoint, not the $default stage, so Terraform can run the local-exec (and GitHub will start delivering webhooks to the URL) before module.multi-runner.module.webhook:resource.aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook exists / has auto-deployed the POST /webhook route — the endpoint would then return errors until the stage deploys. The null_resource should be ordered after the stage is created.
